concerns.text: T009 mandates 'a GLMM (binomial, stratum random intercept, via statsmodels)'. statsmodels has no frequentist binomial GLMM with random intercepts (MixedLM is Gaussian-only; BinomialBayesMixedModel is Bayesian; GEE is not a GLMM). As specified the task is not executable with the named library — either name a workable estimator (GEE with exchangeable correlation, or BinomialBayesMixedModel) or add a dependency that supports binomial GLMMs.

T008 requires 'one row per transformation × test × metric combination (including the untransformed baseline)' conforming to aggregated_result.schema.yaml, but the schema's transformation enum permits only box_cox/yeo_johnson/rank_based. The promised baseline rows cannot be schema-conformant; the task as written cannot pass its own verification. Fix the contract enum (e.g. add 'untransformed') or drop the baseline claim.

T001 requires 'portalocker' file locking, but the pinned dependency list (scikit-learn, scipy, pandas, numpy, seaborn, matplotlib, datasets, pyyaml, statsmodels) does not include it. The isolated-virtualenv execution (Constitution Reproducibility Requirements) will fail on import. Add portalocker to the pinned deps or use stdlib locking (fcntl/msvcrt).

T002 says 'iterate a fixed list of ≥60 verified OpenML dataset IDs' but never states where that list lives or how the implementer obtains/verifies it (plan references a 'Verified datasets' block in research.md, which is not supplied to the task). Name the source file or embed the ID list so the task is self-contained.

T003 excludes datasets with 'no continuous variable' and updates datasets.csv filter_reason, but the schema's filter_reason enum (normal, small_n, missing_too_high, no_group) has no value for that case, so the promised update cannot be written conformantly. Extend the enum or map the reason explicitly.

T005 writes to data/results/type1_error_pilot.json and T007 to results/type1_error/[stratum].json, while plan.md/data-model.md specify results/type1_error_results.csv. Internally consistent within tasks.md and executable as written, but pick one canonical results layout to avoid implementer confusion.
